exposure: Six districts based on administrative districts in Fukushima Prefecture
Great East Japan Earthquake and Fukushima power plant accident
cohort: Pregnant women in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan, from 2011 to 2018
finding: While maternal age, conception rate after sterility treatment, and cesarean section delivery incidence increased in the 8 years following the disaster, there was no significant trend in the occurrence of preterm birth, low birth weight, and anomalies in newborns.
mod_finding: The Great East Japan Earthquake and Fukushima power plant accident were associated with an increased incidence of cesarean section delivery.
birth_weight: Indirectly mentioned through low birth weight
